name: AACT Clinical Trials Database
critical_limitations: Aggregate trial records; account for database access; not individual-level patient records

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
contents: trial protocols, interventions, outcomes, adverse events if posted
critical_limitations: Reporting completeness varies; trial registration or listing is not evidence of benefit

name: openFDA Drug Labels
contents: approved indications, warnings, contraindications, clinical study sections
critical_limitations: Label data may include unapproved products; must inspect record and approval context

name: openFDA FAERS Drug Adverse Events
critical_limitations: Reports do not establish causality, incidence or comparative risks; duplicates and underreporting

name: DailyMed SPL
critical_limitations: Label text is not patient-level efficacy data

name: Drugs@FDA
contents: approval packages, regulatory reviews and drug labeling
critical_limitations: Drug approval is indication/population-specific and cannot be extrapolated to novel compounds

name: FDA Drug Trials Snapshots
contents: select trial participant demographic summaries and findings
critical_limitations: Not a comprehensive machine-readable participant-level training dataset

name: FDA Pharmacogenomic Biomarkers in Drug Labeling
critical_limitations: Biomarker listing does not validate an individual treatment decision

name: PubMed / NCBI E-utilities
critical_limitations: Bibliography is not automatically a standardized labeled training dataset

name: ChEMBL
contents: measured assay activities and assay metadata
critical_limitations: Assay results are not human clinical efficacy

name: PubChem / BioAssay
critical_limitations: Bioactivity cannot be mapped directly to blood pressure or human outcomes

name: EPA CompTox / ToxCast / Tox21
contents: high throughput biological and toxicity assays
critical_limitations: Screening endpoints are not prospective human safety predictions

name: EMA CTIS
contents: European trial records and public results
critical_limitations: Access and completeness vary

name: MIMIC-IV on PhysioNet
critical_limitations: Not universally representative, observational confounding, do not redistribute

name: Vivli individual participant trial data
contents: potential individual-level endpoint and safety evidence
critical_limitations: Restricted; must never scrape or import without authorization

name: Yale Open Data Access
critical_limitations: Restricted, secure access obligations

name: OHDSI / OMOP
critical_limitations: Patient-level records generally remain with data partners

name: TRIPOD+AI Reporting
critical_limitations: Not a dataset or approval

name: PROBAST+AI
contents: structured quality, risk of bias, applicability assessment
critical_limitations: Not a dataset or approval

name: SFDA MDS-G010
critical_limitations: Regulatory review necessary for eligible medical device uses

name: FDA GMLP
contents: principles for medical AI development and monitoring
critical_limitations: Not a certification or approval
